record cards. Repeated records and multiple cards from one context are not

hidden chain-of-thought.

claims.claim: The query is an aminocephalosporin with the same alpha-amino p-hydroxyphenylacetamido side chain as PEPT1-transported beta-lactams; L5 records identify cefadroxil, cephalexin, and ceftibuten as PEPT1 substrates, supporting carrier-mediated intestinal absorption despite low passive permeability.
